sens_en: to raise, to stick up, to warp
origine_fr: 尧, écrit 𭠍 sur 兀, et 羽, la plume, écrit comme 习. 尧 donnait autrefois le son mais se lit aujourd'hui yáo. Au départ, ce sont les longues plumes de la queue, qui se dressent : relever, dresser, 翘尾巴.
origine_en: 尧, written 𭠍 over 兀, plus 羽, feather, written like 习. 尧 once gave the sound but is now read yáo. At first, these were long tail feathers sticking up: to raise, to stick up, 翘尾巴.

mots.en: to stick up, to tilt up

phrase.pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu qiào zhe wěiba pǎo lai le.
phrase.fr: Le petit chien arrive en courant, la queue dressée.
phrase.en: The puppy came running with its tail up.
